issue_request: FHIR-11474 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking to improve the Diagnostics module diagram by aligning shapes and making arrows straight where possible; the resolution was to fix the image as suggested.
initial_application: Historical commit 2d7f54c1d65906343cdc69a239a51781713be51f explicitly says it updated the Diagnostics module graphic for #11474 and modifies images/diagnostic-module-resources.png. A nearby Jira-tagged commit, 35a8969bf68c1644bb5a9ccc35632c8a4df4d5a4, adjusted Diagnostics module prose but did not require an additional diagram source change.
additional_context: The current Diagnostics module page and image are in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, and source/diagnostics-module.html embeds images/diagnostic-module-resources.png as the conceptual resource relationship figure. Git history shows the same image has been updated repeatedly after the original DSTU2 layout fix for later Diagnostics content and R6 resource relationship changes. Community searches found no direct FHIR-11474 conflict; OO 2024 WGM minutes discussed later Diagnostics diagram updates and explanation of arrows/blue-box semantics.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The old non-substantive layout request is already represented by a historical graphic update, and the current diagram appears maintained and serviceable for the current build. Editing only the PNG for optional layout polish would not change implementer understanding and would not meet the reconciliation threshold.
